title: Bridgewell Closing Plans Premium Rate Card
content:
The plan premium figures for the six Real Estate Service Contracts plans are set per plan as follows. Each premium covers the plan's whole buyer term.

## Schedule of premium figures (USD)

| Plan | Base premium | Oversize threshold (living area) | Oversize surcharge | Condominium or townhome deduction | Premium for each additional dwelling unit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Closing Starter | $445.00 | 5000 sq ft | $100.00 | $50.00 | $345.00 |
| Bridgewell Closing Standard | $545.00 | 5000 sq ft | $120.00 | $60.00 | $395.00 |
| Bridgewell Closing Plus | $650.00 | 5000 sq ft | $140.00 | $70.00 | $445.00 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier | $795.00 | 5000 sq ft | $175.00 | $80.00 | $525.00 |
| Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | $1495.00 | 5000 sq ft | $330.00 | $150.00 | $990.00 |
| Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year | $995.00 | 5000 sq ft | $150.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |

## What each figure is

- **Base premium**: the plan premium for one dwelling unit under the oversize threshold, for the full buyer term.
- **Oversize threshold**: the living-area square footage at or above which the oversize surcharge applies. A home of exactly 5000 sq ft is at the threshold; a home of 4999 sq ft is under it.
- **Oversize surcharge**: the amount added to the plan premium for a home at or above the oversize threshold.
- **Condominium or townhome deduction**: the amount deducted from the plan premium for a condominium or a townhome.
- **Additional dwelling unit premium**: the amount added to the plan premium for each dwelling unit beyond the first on a two- to four-unit property.

## Notes on the schedule

- The Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan carries a condominium or townhome deduction of $0.00 and an additional dwelling unit premium of $0.00.
- The oversize threshold is the same 5000 sq ft on every plan; the surcharge applied at that threshold differs by plan.
